dedupe_keys.name: china statistical yearbook 2025 national bureau of statistics of china 28 chapters incl energy transport post and telecoms construction water facilities natural disaster losses and urban development

description: The China Statistical Yearbook is the annual compendium of official statistics from the National Bureau of Statistics of China, published online with editions from 1999 to 2025. The 2025 edition read on 2026-09-28 has 28 chapters, from population, national accounts and prices to energy, construction, transport and post, urban and regional development, and Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan. Infrastructure-relevant tables include the national energy balance and electricity balance, basic transport statistics, post and telecommunications services, water facilities and drained area by province, urban public transport by province, investment in urban environmental infrastructure, and losses from natural disasters, geological hazards, forest fires, earthquakes and marine disasters, mostly for 2024. Coverage is China, with many tables by province. Access is free on the web; the licence was not read, as the site links a separate copyright statement. Caveats: the online tables are linked as images, not spreadsheets, so values must be transcribed or taken from the printed or paid editions, the index is in Chinese with an English version linked, and definitions change between editions. It supports national and provincial studies, such as calibrating a provincial energy or transport demand model or compiling disaster loss series for China. Related record: the 2020 census yearbook housing tables from the same bureau.
